body.statement: Fix \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) and an admissible \(B\) in the sense of the graphical replacement lemma. Does the replacement graphical specification admit finite-alphabet shared-response-function kernels with positive selection probability and non-target kernel stability such that every pooled selected law \(P_{\widetilde\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), \(k\in[K]\), is faithful to its replacement MAG? For any supplied finite-dimensional rational parameterization satisfying the Markov direction, this existence question reduces to atomic determinant nontriviality: for every \(k\in[K]\) and every conditional-independence query that is \(m\)-connected in the replacement MAG, at least one cleared conditional-independence determinant must be a nonzero polynomial on the equality-constrained shared-response-function parameter space. The finite-union exceptional-set argument is valid once these atomic certificates are available; the atomic certificates themselves remain open.
body.justification: This open question separates law-level faithful promotion from the exact fixed-\(A\) graphical identity.
body.gap: For arbitrary admissible replacements, both a directly coupled nonempty open rational parameterization and one nonzero determinant certificate per \(m\)-connected query remain unproved.
body.consumer: An affirmative answer would promote the two graphical endpoint constructions to faithful law-level witnesses, but would not itself provide the finite observable unknown-\(A\) extension needed for canonical equality.

obligation.what_is_open: For every admissible replacement specification, construct a nonempty open rational parameterization of directly coupled shared-exogenous, shared-response twin-SCM tuples satisfying every model-class condition except possibly pooled twin faithfulness; then, for each query that is \(m\)-connected in a replacement MAG, exhibit a cell determinant that is not the zero polynomial on that parameter space.
obligation.obstruction: Generic faithfulness for unrestricted multinomial DAGs does not establish nontriviality after one common basal selection response, fixed one-half pooling, non-target response equalities, and same-realized-exogenous cross-world coupling are imposed. The graphical replacement lemma controls projection signatures but supplies neither a coupled probability parameter space nor an atomic dependence witness.
obligation.attempted: The finite exceptional-set argument was completed on any supplied directly coupled rational parameter family: all unfaithfulness events become determinant zero sets and a product-polynomial argument selects one simultaneous faithful point once atomic nontriviality holds. This argument cannot prove that the constrained family exists for every replacement or that a required determinant does not vanish identically.
obligation.partial_result: For any supplied nonempty open set \(\Theta\subset\mathbb R^r\) that directly parameterizes finite-alphabet tuples already carrying one product exogenous law, the same realized exogenous vector in every world, response functions shared off target, one basal pre-intervention selection response, positive basal selection probability, and every other model-class condition except possibly pooled twin faithfulness, the remaining genericity step is finite and algebraic. If the pooled selected cell masses are strictly positive rational functions with positive denominators and the Markov direction holds, conditional independence is equivalent to the vanishing of finitely many cleared determinant polynomials. Choosing one nonzero polynomial for each \(m\)-connected query and taking their product yields a point \(\theta^\star\) at which all pooled laws are simultaneously faithful. Conversely, simultaneous faithfulness implies that at least one determinant polynomial for each \(m\)-connected query is nonzero. What remains unproved is the construction of such a directly coupled nonempty open rational parameter family for every admissible replacement and the atomic nontriviality certificate for every \(m\)-connected query on that constrained family.
